4. As already noticed all the courts below including the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division decreed the suit. 

 5. Mr. Md. Fazlul Karim, learned Advocate appearing for the defendant-petitioner submits that the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division acted illegally and wrongly in affirming the judgment and decree of the courts below as the suit was not maintainable for non-compliance of the mandatory provision of Section 91(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure as no sanction was obtained from the Attorney General as pro-vided under the Code as the allegations made in the plaint are public nuisances.
